description: This file defines a report parser class for account reporting in OpenERP, including methods for calculating totals and generating report lines with hierarchical account data.

classes.name: account_report_bs
classes.description: A report parser class for generating account balance sheet reports, with methods to compute totals and organize report lines hierarchically.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the report parser, setting up local context with time and lines methods.

methods.name: line_total
methods.description: Calculates the total balance for a report line, including child reports and associated accounts.

methods.name: lines
methods.description: Generates a hierarchical list of report lines with account and report data, supporting nested structures.
